text_block_list.text: Aston Machan, having left a deep impression in people's hearts and memories, and having successfully become the official URA mascot, safely made it through the three years.

One day, as I was thinking about
our next goal together...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Did you hear?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Tada.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It seems the Chan-chan dolls have arrived at Umamusume shops across Asia as well.

Looking at the screen shown to me...
There was a photo of Machan dolls lined up on display at a shop abroad.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Expanding further from Asia,
and out into the rest of the world.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I can never thank the staff in the
Planning & Development Department enough.
A few days ago—

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text: "To be honest, ever since I first heard about it, I've been wondering if there was anything I could do."

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text: It's very rare to see an Umamusume so enthusiastic about merchandise, so I was simply thrilled...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Mhm, mhm.

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text: I was relieved when we successfully managed to get merchandise made, but...

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
When I saw Aston Machan's race in the
Sprinters Stakes the other day,
it was like a lightning bolt struck me!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ooh.

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
"We can't just be satisfied with releasing it!
We need to expand it more and more!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
In other words, we expand even further overseas from here!
First step, neighbouring Asian countries!
What do you think?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes, please!!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I went to talk to her
back right after my debut.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There are so many Umamusume.
Without that, I'm sure you wouldn't have
cared about Chan-me this much.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I can't say it's ready for "one in every household" just yet.
We're still just getting started.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“Still.
If you're carrying this much right now, I'm sure it'll be fine.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The future is surely in safe hands.

Aston Machan then looked at the
Machan doll displayed by the window.

It was the first official Chan-me doll
she gave me before the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...What are you going to do, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: If you no longer need this doll... what will you do with it, Trainer?

...Setting aside whether the day will come when it's no longer needed,
if we're talking hypotheticals—
choice_data_list: I think they're probably putting it away.

text_block_list.text: I'll clean it up nicely and tuck it away somewhere safe so I don't lose it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'll keep it clean and make sure not to lose it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. Sounds good.
Yes, please do.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
As long as you don't lose it,
you'll be able to travel through time.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Humans say they feel nostalgic
when an old mascot turns up from inside a drawer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I remembered—that cute girl who was
so popular back in the day, was it..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: In other words, this is a story about the distant future, when Trainer has become an old grandpa.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: In other words, this is a story about the distant future, when Trainer has become an old grandma.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Even if it gets overwritten by all kinds of memories,
and I end up completely forgetting everything.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: If I can just see this doll again, surely—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Aah, what a blast from the past.
I almost forgot there used to be a kid like that.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if I can't remember their name.
Even if I can't quite picture their face."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Running races, doing training...
I realized that's just how I spent every single day.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Because then you'll be able to remember Chan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...No. That's not it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I want you...
to remember."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: So, I'm counting on you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes... It's a promise.

The days spent with Aston Machan
will remain, carefully stitched into memory.
Now, from here on—even in the distant future.
